document: Erste Bank account or credit card statement with balances and a transaction list, Hungarian
glossary: Document type: Erste Bank account or credit card statement with balances and a transaction list, Hungarian. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.statement_type: the statement type as printed on the document
field_specs.account_no: the account no as printed on the document
field_specs.account_iban: the account iban as printed on the document
field_specs.period_start: the period start as printed on the document (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)
field_specs.period_end: the period end as printed on the document (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)
field_specs.currency: the currency as printed on the document
field_specs.opening_balance: the opening balance as printed on the document (plain decimal STRING, dot separator, may be negative (D4))
field_specs.closing_balance: the closing balance as printed on the document (plain decimal STRING)
field_specs.total_debit: the total debit as printed on the document (POSITIVE magnitude as STRING)
field_specs.total_credit: the total credit as printed on the document (POSITIVE magnitude as STRING)
